module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Report products that need reordering based on stock levels.

import std.json
import std.filesystem
import std.environment
import std.console

public type Product
  purpose: A product with inventory information.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer where stock is at least 0
  has reorder_level: Integer where reorder_level is at least 0
end

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, filesystem.read, environment
  purpose: Read products from a JSON file and print those below reorder level.

  let args be environment.arguments()
  if args.length is 0 then
    fail with AppError(message: "Usage: reorder <json_file>")
  end

  let file_path be args.first() otherwise fail with AppError(message: "No file path provided")
  let json_text be filesystem.read_text(file_path) otherwise fail with AppError(message: "Cannot read file")
  let products_data be json.parse(json_text) otherwise fail with AppError(message: "Invalid JSON")

  let products be parse_products(data: products_data) otherwise fail with AppError(message: "Invalid product data")

  let low_stock be
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock ascending
    collect product

  for each product in low_stock
    console.print("{product.name}: {product.stock} (reorder at {product.reorder_level})")
  end
end

function parse_products(data) returns List of Product or fails with ParseError
  purpose: Convert parsed JSON data into a list of products.

  match data
    when success(value) then
      let products be []
      return products
    when failure(error) then
      fail with ParseError(detail: error.to_text())
  end
end

public type AppError
  purpose: An error that occurred during program execution.
  has message: Text
end

public type ParseError
  purpose: An error parsing product data.
  has detail: Text
end

module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Report products that need reordering based on stock levels.

import std.json
import std.filesystem
import std.console

public type Product
  purpose: A product with inventory information.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer where stock is at least 0
  has reorder_level: Integer where reorder_level is at least 0
end

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, filesystem.read
  purpose: Read products from a JSON file and print those below reorder level.

  let args be std.environment.arguments()
  let path be
    if args.length is at least 1 then
      args.at(0)
    otherwise
      fail with AppError(message: "Usage: reorder <json_file>")
    end
  end

  let text be std.filesystem.read_text(path: path) otherwise fail with AppError(message: "Cannot read file")
  let products be parse_products(text: text) otherwise fail with AppError(message: "Invalid JSON format")

  let low_stock be
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock ascending
    collect product
  end

  for each product in low_stock
    std.console.print("{product.name}: {product.stock} units (reorder at {product.reorder_level})")
  end
end

function parse_products(text: Text) returns List of Product or fails with ParseError
  purpose: Parse a JSON array of products.
  example: parse_products(text: "[{\"name\":\"Widget\",\"stock\":5,\"reorder_level\":10}]") is [Product(name: "Widget", stock: 5, reorder_level: 10)]

  let parsed be std.json.parse(text: text) otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Invalid JSON")
  let items be
    match parsed
      when list(values) then values
      otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Root must be an array")
    end
  end

  let products be
    for each item in items
    collect extract_product(item: item) otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Invalid product object")
  end

  return products
end

function extract_product(item: any) returns Product or fails with ParseError
  purpose: Extract a Product from a JSON object.

  match item
    when object(fields) then
      let name be get_text_field(fields: fields, key: "name") otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Missing or invalid name")
      let stock be get_integer_field(fields: fields, key: "stock") otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Missing or invalid stock")
      let reorder_level be get_integer_field(fields: fields, key: "reorder_level") otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Missing or invalid reorder_level")
      return Product(name: name, stock: stock, reorder_level: reorder_level)
    otherwise
      fail with ParseError(detail: "Product must be an object")
  end
end

function get_text_field(fields: Map of Text to any, key: Text) returns Text or fails with ParseError
  purpose: Extract a text field from a JSON object.

  let value be fields.get(key: key) otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Field not found")
  match value
    when text(str) then return str
    otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Field is not text")
  end
end

function get_integer_field(fields: Map of Text to any, key: Text) returns Integer or fails with ParseError
  purpose: Extract an integer field from a JSON object.

  let value be fields.get(key: key) otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Field not found")
  match value
    when number(num) then
      let int_val be num.to_integer() otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Field is not an integer")
      return int_val
    otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Field is not a number")
  end
end

public type AppError
  purpose: An error that occurred during program execution.
  has message: Text
end

public type ParseError
  purpose: An error that occurred while parsing JSON.
  has detail: Text
end

end

  let stock be 0
  let reorder_level be 0
